== Unique Class Weapons ==
<noinclude>
In addition to the changes listed here, all melee weapons also gain <span class="nmod">Melee Attacks Deal Splash Damage</span>.

Ethereal weapons gain a x1.25 damage bonus instead of a x1.5 damage bonus.
</noinclude>
=== Amazon ===

==== Bows ====
<noinclude>
All bows now gain bonus damage equal to 50% dexterity instead of 100% dexterity.
</noinclude>

* The <span class="nmod">Level 30 [[Armageddon]] when Equipped</span> is not active in towns (functionally and visually).
* Despite being called a Phase Blade (and sharing some of its characteristics), this item is a new  Two-Handed, Paladin Only sword base.
** The [[Paladin]], in his idle pose, holds it like a one-handed sword, but holds it like a two-handed sword while walking/running and attacking.
** This item base is only available on this item and will not drop elsewhere in the game.
